--- is_distinct_from_arithmetic.sql
1 + 2 IS DISTINCT FROM 3 | 4

--- AST
&ast.IsDistinctFromExpr{
  Left: &ast.BinaryExpr{
    Op:   "+",
    Left: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValueEnd: 1,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "1",
    },
    Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 4,
      ValueEnd: 5,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "2",
    },
  },
  Right: &ast.BinaryExpr{
    Op:   "|",
    Left: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 23,
      ValueEnd: 24,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "3",
    },
    Right: &ast.IntLiteral{
      ValuePos: 27,
      ValueEnd: 28,
      Base:     10,
      Value:    "4",
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
1 + 2 IS DISTINCT FROM 3 | 4
